<stasis/>Stasis Subclass Only
Replaces Dodge with Shift.
Shift has a travel distance of 10 metres, and renders you completely invisible and invulnerable (except for a trail) for the duration of the shift.

Dodging grants Light Shift buff for 10 seconds.
Class Ability Energy does not recharge while Light Shift is active.

<pve [PVE] Light Shift grants 10% increased damage to Slowed/Frozen Combatants, as well as granting 10% increased damage to Arc Weapons. />

Replaces Dodge with Shift if you have a <stasis/>Stasis or <arc/>Arc Super equipped. (<bold Does not work /> with <solar/>Acrobat's Dodge)

Shift effectively acts as a fast horizontal teleport and has a travel distance of 10 meters. Shift renders you completely invisible (except for a trail) and invulnerable for the duration of the animation.

Casting Shift grants one stack of 'Light Shift' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Light Shift grants 10%|21%|33% increased <arc/>Arc, <stasis/>Stasis, and <yellow Lord of Wolves /> Weapon Damage at 1|2|3 Stacks.

Light Shift additionally grants 10% increased Weapon Damage against <stasis/>Stasis-debuffed enemies.

Light Shift's buffs stack with all other buff sources.

Passive Class Ability regeneration is disabled for the duration of Light Shift. Instead, Weapon Kills grant 50?% Class Ability Energy while Light Shift is active.
